title: Achievements and Prospects of Electrification in the Soviet Union
printed_title: 36. Achievements and Prospects of Electrification in the Soviet Union

prose.text:
The original textbook records the adoption of the State Electrification Plan for Russia in 1920, describing it as the first long-term plan in human history for developing a national economy on the basis of electrification.
It identifies V. I. Lenin as the plan's initiator and advocate, and states that he regarded electrification as decisive for transforming the country's economy.
prose.source_text: 1920 年通过了人类历史上第一个以电气化为基础的发展国民经济远景规划——俄罗斯国家电气化规划. В·И·列宁是制定这一计划的首创者和号召者. 列宁认为电气化在国家经济改造中有决定性的意义.

historical_entities.source_term: 俄罗斯国家电气化规划
historical_entities.reason: p0101#4 explicitly names this historical plan; the translation retains its identity and attributes the first-in-history claim to the textbook.
The country name occurs in the plan named in p0101#4; it is not replaced with a fictional setting.
p0101#4 supplies these initials and the person's role; initials are transliterated without expanding the source name.

prose.text: The original textbook quotes V. I. Lenin: "Only when the country has been electrified, only when the technical foundations of modern large-scale industry have been introduced into industry, agriculture, and transportation, can we achieve final victory."
prose.source_text: В·И·列宁说：“只有在国家实现电气化时，只有在把现代大规模的工业技术基础引入工业、农业和交通运输业中的时候，我们才能取得最后的胜利.”

historical_entities.reason: p0101#5 attributes the entire quotation to this person; all conditions, sectors, and the political conclusion are translated, not omitted.

prose.text:
The original textbook presents the preceding half-century of development as convincing evidence of the "great power" of Lenin's ideas.
It states that, compared with 1913, the State Electrification Plan for Russia called for industrial production to double and electricity production to reach 4 times its level.

According to the textbook, after 10 years the plan had exceeded all its targets ahead of the specified deadline.
It also describes electrification as accelerating year by year, and reports that in 1947 the Soviet Union ranked first in Europe and second in the world in electricity production.
prose.source_text: 过去的半个世纪令人信服地证明了列宁思想的伟大力量. 俄罗斯国家电气化规划规定了与 1913 年比较，工业生产要翻一番，电能的生产要增加到 4 倍. 这个计划在规定的期限之前（经过 10 年）全部指标都超额完成了. 电气化的速度年复一年的增长，到 1947 年苏联在电能生产上居欧洲第一位，居世界第二位.

historical_entities.reason: p0101#6 gives a political appraisal of his ideas; it remains explicitly the textbook's appraisal.

historical_entities.source_term: 俄罗斯国家电气化规划
historical_entities.reason: p0101#6 gives this plan's baseline, production targets, and completion narrative.
The historical country identity in the plan's source name is retained.
p0101#6 assigns the electricity rankings to this historical state in the specified year; no current ranking is asserted.

prose.text:
The word "now" in the original textbook refers to the period when it was written.
In the book's comparison, the Soviet Union then produced nearly five times as much electricity in a single day as it had in the whole of 1921, which the book identifies as the first year of implementing the nationwide electrification plan.
prose.source_text: 现在我国一天生产的电能是 1921 年（实行全国电气化计划的第一年）全年生产量的将近五倍.

historical_entities.reason: The source's national self-reference in p0101#7 and p0102#1 belongs to this lesson's Soviet historical account; translation makes the referent explicit without changing it.

prose.text:
In the figures reported by the original textbook for its own period, hydroelectric stations supplied about $20\%$ of the Soviet Union's total electricity.
The book describes the Krasnoyarsk Hydroelectric Power Station as named for the anniversary marking 50 years since the founding of the Soviet Union, and calls it the world's largest hydroelectric station at that time.

It also describes the station's hydroelectric generating units as the world's most powerful at that time, giving their power as 500000 kilowatts.
The book gives the station's total power as six million kilowatts.
prose.source_text: 水力发电站生产的电能占我国全部电能的 $20\%$ 左右. 世界上现今规模最大的水力发电站是以苏联建国 50 周年纪念日命名的克拉斯诺雅尔斯克水电站. 在这个水电站里安装了世界上最大功率（500000 千瓦特）的水轮机组. 这个电站的总功率达到六百万千瓦.

historical_entities.reason: p0102#2 explicitly names the state's founding anniversary and gives its contemporary hydroelectric share.

historical_entities.source_term: 克拉斯诺雅尔斯克水电站
historical_entities.reason: p0102#2 identifies the actual station, commemorative naming, and powers; both world-largest claims are limited to the textbook's historical account.

prose.text:
The original textbook describes a trend toward higher-power thermal power stations.
According to its figures for that period, large numbers of thermal stations in the Soviet Union each had a power of more than one million kilowatts, and many exceeded two million kilowatts.
It gives the power of the Krivorozhsk Thermal Power Station as three million kilowatts and describes it as the world's largest thermal power station at that time.
prose.source_text: 至于火力发电站，它们也向增大功率的方向发展. 现在苏联大批火力发电站各站功率都超过一百万千瓦，其中很多功率超过二百万千瓦. 而克里沃罗日斯克火力发电站功率达到三百万千瓦，是现代世界上最大的火力发电站.

historical_entities.reason: p0102#3 explicitly assigns the thermal-power figures to this historical state and period.

historical_entities.source_term: 克里沃罗日斯克火力发电站
historical_entities.reason: p0102#3 supplies the actual station's name and power; the English name transliterates the supplied name without adding a modern replacement or current ranking.

prose.text:
The original textbook states that high-power nuclear power stations were beginning to play an increasingly important role in power engineering.
It also records a resolution of the Twenty-Fifth Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union giving priority to the development of nuclear energy in the European part of the Soviet Union.
prose.source_text: 大功率的原子能发电站在电力工程上开始起着越来越大的作用，苏共第二十五次代表大会决议规定在苏联的欧洲部分优先发展原子能.

historical_entities.term: Twenty-Fifth Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
historical_entities.source_term: 苏共第二十五次代表大会
historical_entities.reason: p0102#4 explicitly names this historical congress and its resolution; institution, congress number, and policy are retained in translation.
p0102#4 explicitly limits the policy to the European part of this historical state.

prose.text:
The original textbook describes a unified all-Soviet power system then taking shape by connecting the power systems of Siberia and Central Asia with those of the European part of the Soviet Union.
It explains that these connections improved the reliability and flexibility of electricity supply across the country's vast territory.
According to the textbook, this task required the construction of transmission trunk lines operating at 500000 volts, 750000 volts, and 1150000 volts.
prose.source_text: 利用把西伯利亚和中亚的动力系统与我国欧洲部分的动力系统联合的方法，正在形成统一的全苏电力系统. 这就提高了在我国辽阔疆土上供电的可靠性和机动性. 解决这个任务要求建造 500000 伏、750000 伏和 1150000 伏的输电干线.

historical_entities.reason: p0102#5 names this historical interconnection project; its ongoing construction is limited to the textbook's period.
p0102#5 explicitly identifies this real region as part of the connection.
p0102#5 explicitly identifies this real region as part of the connection.

data.title: 苏联电气化的成就和远景
data.printed_title: 36. 苏联电气化的成就和远景

prose.text: 1920 年通过了人类历史上第一个以电气化为基础的发展国民经济远景规划——俄罗斯国家电气化规划. В·И·列宁是制定这一计划的首创者和号召者. 列宁认为电气化在国家经济改造中有决定性的意义.
В·И·列宁说：“只有在国家实现电气化时，只有在把现代大规模的工业技术基础引入工业、农业和交通运输业中的时候，我们才能取得最后的胜利.”
过去的半个世纪令人信服地证明了列宁思想的伟大力量. 俄罗斯国家电气化规划规定了与 1913 年比较，工业生产要翻一番，电能的生产要增加到 4 倍. 这个计划在规定的期限之前（经过 10 年）全部指标都超额完成了. 电气化的速度年复一年的增长，到 1947 年苏联在电能生产上居欧洲第一位，居世界第二位.
现在我国一天生产的电能是 1921 年（实行全国电气化计划的第一年）全年生产量的将近五倍.
水力发电站生产的电能占我国全部电能的 $20\%$ 左右. 世界上现今规模最大的水力发电站是以苏联建国 50 周年纪念日命名的克拉斯诺雅尔斯克水电站. 在这个水电站里安装了世界上最大功率（500000 千瓦特）的水轮机组. 这个电站的总功率达到六百万千瓦.
至于火力发电站，它们也向增大功率的方向发展. 现在苏联大批火力发电站各站功率都超过一百万千瓦，其中很多功率超过二百万千瓦. 而克里沃罗日斯克火力发电站功率达到三百万千瓦，是现代世界上最大的火力发电站.
大功率的原子能发电站在电力工程上开始起着越来越大的作用，苏共第二十五次代表大会决议规定在苏联的欧洲部分优先发展原子能.
利用把西伯利亚和中亚的动力系统与我国欧洲部分的动力系统联合的方法，正在形成统一的全苏电力系统. 这就提高了在我国辽阔疆土上供电的可靠性和机动性. 解决这个任务要求建造 500000 伏、750000 伏和 1150000 伏的输电干线.
